A '''neelig''' was a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Snake/Legends|serpent]] that invaded homes on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> At some point after the creature had gone extinct, "Neelig" had become an Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|male]] given name, being associated with quickness.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The neelig was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
